H219.def: luminousness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity; also a plant (as being bright)

H221.def: Uri, the name of three Israelites
senses: 1) a prince of Judah, a son of Hur who was used by God to prepare the tabernacle
2) an officer (or the father of an officer) of Solomon in Gilead
3) a porter or gatekeeper in time of Ezra who took a foreign woman as wife

H222.def: Uriel, the name of two Israelites
senses: 1) chief of the Levitical line of Kohath in David's time

H223.def: Urijah, the name of one Hittite and five Israelites
senses: Uriah or Urijah = "Jehovah (Yahweh) is my light (flame)"
2) a priest who built king Ahaz' heathen altar
3) a priest who rebuilt Jerusalem's wall
H223.deriv: or (prolonged) אוּרִיָּהוּ ; from {H217} and {H3050}; flame of Jah;

H224.def: Urim, the oracular brilliancy of the figures in the high-priest's breastplate
senses: 1) stones kept in a pouch on the high-priest's breastplate, used in determining God's decision in certain questions and issues

H225.def: properly, to come, i.e. (implied) to assent

H226.def: a signal (literally or figuratively), as aflag, beacon, monument, omen, prodigy, evidence, etc.
H226.deriv: probably from {H225} (in the sense of appearing);

H227.def: at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore
H227.kjv: beginning, for, from, hitherto, now, of old, once, since, then, at which time, yet.

senses: 1) father of one of David's mighty men
1) hyssop, a plant used for medicinal and religious purposes

H232.def: something girt; a belt, also a band
senses: 1) waist-cloth, the innermost piece of clothing
1) memorial-offering, the portion of the meal (food) offering which is burned

H235.def: to go away, hence, to disappear
senses: 1) to go, to go away, to go about
1a3) to be used up, be exhausted, be gone, evaporated
H235.kjv: fail, gad about, go to and fro (but in Ezekiel 27:19 the word is rendered by many 'from Uzal,' by others 'yarn'), be gone (spent).

H237.def: Ezel, a memorial stone in Palestine
senses: 1) a memorial stone between Ramah and Nob; scene of final farewell between David and Jonathan

H238.def: to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen
senses: 1a3) to hear or listen to prayers (of God)
H238.deriv: a primitive root; probably to expand; but used only as a denominative from {H241};
H238.kjv: give (perceive by the) ear, hear(-ken). See {H239}.

H239.deriv: a primitive root (rather identical with {H238} through the idea of scales as if two ears);

H240.def: a spade or paddle (as having a broad end)

H241.def: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)
senses: 1) ear, as part of the body
3) (subjective) to uncover the ear to reveal; the receiver of divine revelation
H241.kjv: [phrase] advertise, audience, [phrase] displease, ear, hearing, [phrase] show.

senses: 1) city built by Sherah, Ephraim's daughter
H242.deriv: from {H238} and {H7609}; plot of Sheerah (i.e. settled by him);

senses: 1) a pair of hills on Naphtali's border
H243.deriv: from {H238} and {H8396}; flats (i.e. tops) of Tabor (i.e. situated on it);

H244.def: Ozni, an Israelite; also an Oznite (collectively), his descendant
senses: 2) pertaining to Ozni and his descendants
1) the father of Jeshua, a Levite
1a) (Qal) to gird, gird on (metaphorical of strength)

H249.def: a spontaneous growth, i.e. native (tree or persons)
senses: 1) a native (one rising from the soil)
H249.deriv: from {H2224} (in the sense of springing up);
H249.kjv: bay tree, (home-) born (in the land), of the (one's own) country (nation).
